Investors also weighed a batch of Big Tech earnings reports, which could help power a rebound after the previous session’s Federal Reserve-fueled selloff.  Microsoft  advanced 9.4% in premarket trading after the software giant reported strong fiscal fourth-quarter results and said its capital expenditures guidance for the year remained the same, easing fears about overspending on artificial intelligence.
